name: Campana and cascara ride
desc: Timbale-forward mambo drive: a busy accented mambo cowbell (campana) rides steady eighths over a syncopated cascara shell ostinato on rimshots, anchored by an explicit son clave in 2-3 orientation. Maracas fill the 16ths, opposite-phase pan and filter sweeps breathe, and a guiro euclid rotates at peak.

code.full: stack(s("clave").struct("<[~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~] [x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~]>").gain(${gain}*.9).room(.3).pan(.4), s("cb*8").gain("[.45 .28 .4 .3 .43 .28 .4 .32]").hpf(650).pan(sine.range(.52, .68).slow(16)), s("[rim ~ rim rim ~ rim ~ rim]*2").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.5, ${shk}).fast(4)).hpf(1200).pan(cosine.range(.3, .48).slow(16)), s("sh*16").gain("[.16 .08 .12 .07]*4").hpf(6000).pan(.6)).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("clave").struct("<[~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~] [x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~]>").gain(${gain}*.9).room(.3).pan(.4), s("cb*8").gain("[.47 .3 .42 .32 .45 .3 .42 .34]").hpf(650).pan(sine.range(.5, .7).slow(12)), s("[rim ~ rim rim ~ rim ~ rim]*2").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.55, ${shk}).fast(4)).hpf(1300).pan(cosine.range(.28, .5).slow(12)), s("sh*16").gain("[.18 .09 .14 .08]*4").hpf(6500).pan(.62), s("guiro(5,8,<0 2 4>)").gain(${shk}*.8).speed(1.1).room(.2).pan(.68)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(2).play()
